name: Hermogenes
title: One Who Deserted Paul
summary: Hermogenes was a Christian from the province of Asia mentioned by the apostle Paul as one who turned away from him. He represents those who deserted Paul during a difficult time, possibly during his imprisonment in Rome.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as One Who Deserted Paul
keyEvents.description: Paul writes to Timothy that everyone in Asia has turned away from him, including Phygellus and Hermogenes. This likely happened during Paul's second imprisonment in Rome.
